_hinweis: User interface texts of AKA Recht, English. One key per text; {name} are placeholders that the program fills and that must stay unchanged in every language. Keys wert.<value> translate fixed values from akte.json for display only (the values in the files stay German).
app.lokal_klein: No cloud service, no external fonts.
app.oeffnen_text: The local connection is loading. If you opened this file directly, please start Start.command in the Recht folder.
app.keine_verbindung: No connection to the service. Please open Start.command in the Recht folder.
allg.unbekannte_aktion: Unknown action “{aktion}”. This is a bug in the user interface.
home.beispiel_hinweis: Made-up case for trying things out, can be deleted at any time
home.kein_fall_text: Create a case as soon as you want to organise a legal matter. A parking ticket or an invoice is a case too.
home.naechste_fristen_text: From all files. The check status stays visible.
home.so_weiter_text: Put new mail into the inbox, assign it to a case, then file it in the case and enter deadlines.
home.keine_sicherung: No backup created with the new service yet.
faelle.untertitel: One matter, one fixed identifier. Closed cases stay in the same place.
faelle.vertraege_text: Documents without a dispute stay in the general filing. As soon as you want to work on them, they become a case.
eingang.untertitel: Collect documents and assign them to the right case. The file is moved once, never overwritten.
eingang.frei_text: Collect new PDFs, letters and e-mails here while the case is still unclear. If it is known, add them directly under Documents in the case.
fristen.titel: Deadlines and appointments of all cases
fristen.untertitel: Sorted by date. Red: within seven days or passed. Yellow: within three weeks. A calendar date is not a confirmation of a statutory deadline.
fristen.keine_text: Deadlines are entered in the respective case file, with trigger, legal basis and calculation.
quellen.untertitel: Direct access to official offerings. The app does not download any legislation. Check the version and period of validity in the full text for every legal question.
quellen.suchen: For example federal law, court, fine …
bestand.pruefen: Check the inventory of all cases
bestand.pruefen_text: Compares every registered file with its first checksum. Detects changed and missing files. Does not confirm legal correctness.
bestand.ebenen: The backup is an unencrypted ZIP file. Local means: on this computer. A cloud folder is uploaded by the operating system. Whatever your AI reads is processed by its provider. Targets are set in the settings.
bestand.keine_sicherung: No backup documented with the new service yet.
bestand.sicherung_text: The ZIP file is read completely and compared with the working copy. A copy goes to the second target if it is reachable. Earlier backups are kept. “Test the restore” unpacks the last backup into a temporary folder and compares it.
bestand.laeuft: Check running, every registered file is being read …
bestand.ergebnis: {fall}: {geprueft} unchanged, {veraendert} changed, {fehlend} missing, {ohne} without identifier, {verschoben} detected as moved.
bestand.block_ohne: Without identifier (matched when the case is opened)
bestand.geprueft_um: Checked {zeit}. A checksum proves identity with the registered state, not authenticity or evidential value.
bestand.probe_laeuft: Test running: the archive is being unpacked and checked …
bestand.probe_fall: {fall}: {geprueft} files match, {veraendert} changed, {fehlend} missing, {schema} schema errors
bestand.sicherung_hinweis: All files are packed, the ZIP file is read back completely and compared. For large folders this can take up to a minute.
einst.ziel_hinweis: Folder outside the project. It is created if it does not exist.
einst.zweites_ziel_hinweis: For example a folder in iCloud Drive. Leave empty if there is none.
einst.absender_text: Used in “From:” and in the signature when a draft is created from a template. If a case has a party with the role “Me” and an address, that one applies. Stays in zentrale.json on this computer.
einst.name: Name
einst.bundesland_hinweis: The deadline calculator moves the end of a period under § 193 BGB only on public holidays that apply throughout this state. What counts is the place where performance is due (for example the seat of the court or the authority). Regional holidays are not taken into account.
einst.sprache_hinweis: Labels and guide only. The data in the case files and the messages of the service stay German.
dok.nichts_text: Try a different search or reset the filters. Add new files with “Add document” or put them into 01 Eingang in {dm}.
bet.untertitel: Who is involved, in which role, under which reference number.
bet.name: Name
bet.keine_text: Opponent, court, authority, lawyer, witnesses. Documents and proceedings refer to these identifiers.
verf.untertitel: Several proceedings within one conflict are kept apart, with separate deadlines.
verf.keins_text: Proceedings are anything with its own body and its own reference number: a lawsuit, a fine notice, an objection, a dunning procedure, a criminal complaint.
chron.untertitel: Events by evidenced point in time. Receipt, dispatch and document date are different things.
fristen_fall.untertitel: “Confirmed” only with trigger, legal basis, calculation and source. The calculator does not decide which deadline applies.
fristen_fall.keine_text: Every deadline with trigger, legal basis, calculation and source. The calculator helps with the calculation.
entw.untertitel: Texts not yet sent. The file name ends with _ENTWURF. Sending only after your approval, then keep the proof as a document.
entw.eingefroren_meldung: Version {n} frozen as “{status}”: the copy under 06 Entwürfe/Fassungen is read-only and has its own identifier.
entw.keiner: No draft recorded yet. A draft stays a draft until the dispatch is evidenced.
entw.keine_dateien: No files in the folder 06 Entwürfe.
anl.verzeichnis_text: Assignment of existing files to exhibit identifiers. Not proof of which set was actually filed.
anl.keine: No exhibit identifiers assigned yet. Use “Organise” on a document.
journal.untertitel: Course of the case, append only. Tasks and deadlines do not belong here.
vorschau.fehlt: The file is missing at the registered location. Re-read the inventory or look in {dm}.
vorschau.keine_anzeige: There is no embedded viewer for {typ}. “Text” shows the content, “Open” starts the matching program.
vorschau.ocr_text: Reads the writing with the program tesseract on this computer and stores the result as a separate text file under 07 Recherche. The original stays unchanged; recognised text is a derivative.
vorschau.aus_ocr: This text comes from text recognition
vorschau.aus_ocr_pruefen: Check figures, dates and names against the original.
dialog.entfernen_hinweis: Only possible if nothing refers to it.
personen.suchen: Search person: identifier, name or role
form.verfahren_art_hinweis: e.g. labour court action, fine proceedings, objection, dunning procedure
form.zeitpunkt_hinweis: For anything other than “exact”, the date is only the sorting date.
form.bekannt_hinweis: e.g. “early September according to a colleague”
form.einzelheiten_hinweis: What does the document say, what is your own statement, what is the other side claiming?
form.fristende: End of the deadline or appointment
form.ausloeser_ereignis_hinweis: “confirmed” only with an exactly dated event.
form.rechtsgrundlage_hinweis: Provision with paragraph and act, e.g. § 67 Abs. 1 OWiG
form.pruefstatus_hinweis: “confirmed” only with trigger, basis, calculation and source.
form.geprueft_von_hinweis: Only for “confirmed”: who checked the calculation, the evidence and the legal basis. The folder sets the check date when saving; the calculation must state the end of the deadline, and open markers block the confirmation.
form.datei_hinweis: Path inside the case folder, e.g. 06 Entwürfe/Einspruch_ENTWURF.txt
ordnen.hinweis: Filing data only. File, file name and content stay unchanged.
ordnen.textstand_hinweis: what was actually read from the content
ordnen.anlage_hinweis: e.g. K 8 or B 1, as used in the pleading
vorlage.hinweis: Sender, signature and date come from the settings or from the party with the role “Me”. All other placeholders 【…】 stay in place for you to fill in. Nothing is overwritten.
einsortieren.unterordner_hinweis: optional, e.g. An Vorstand or Versandnachweise
einsortieren.hinweis: Identifier and content are kept. A file with the same name at the target is never overwritten.
neuerfall.rolle_hinweis: e.g. person concerned, tenant, employee, buyer
neuerfall.ziel: What do you want to achieve?
neuerfall.hinweis: Type of proceedings, competent body and dates of receipt stay open until the documents have been read. Nothing is derived from file names.
fallbearb.rechtsordnung_hinweis: DE; for cross-border matters the country and language
journal_dialog.text_hinweis: Refer to identifiers such as D0012, F01, A03. The entry is appended, never rewritten.
rechner.titel: Deadline calculator (§§ 187, 188, 193 BGB, public holidays as set in the settings)
rechner.nicht_mit: not included (§ 187 Abs. 1, the normal case)
rechner.verschieben: move to the next working day (§ 193)
rechner.nur_rechnen: Calculates only. To record a deadline use “Deadline or appointment”; the same calculator is there and applies the result to the fields.
rechner.kein_start: Please enter the day of the event.
rechner.dauer_min: The duration must be at least 1.
zuordnen.fertig: Assigned, the file is now in the inbox of the case.
upload.zu_gross: {name}: larger than 25 MB, please put it into {dm}.
meld.ocr_laeuft: Text recognition running, this can take a few seconds per page …
meld.ocr_fertig: Text recognition created: {id}, {seiten} page(s), {zeichen} characters. Check figures, dates and names against the original.
anleitung.titel: How you work with AKA Recht
anleitung.fehlt: The guide for this language is missing (sprachen/anleitung.<language>.html).
